verdict.rationale: Devin's docs describe a hosted cloud agent. Users delegate tasks to 'cloud Devin' via /handoff, the web app, or Slack/Teams. Sessions run on Devin's own machines and workspaces, including macOS VMs, Android emulation and Windows. Multiple Devins can run in parallel, sessions can be created through the API, and every session boots from a pre-configured environment, so the user does not run backend infrastructure. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that no self-managed infrastructure is required, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the managed hosting experience.
